description: Get the account's plan and how many of its active transfers are in use. Free accounts have no active-transfer cap; lookup and request rate limits still apply. On a paid plan, a finished transfer keeps its place until it archives itself a week after its last check, and can be archived sooner to free the place. Archived transfers stay in the account and never count. On a custom package, also how many transfers were added in the current billing period against the package's volume, and when it resets. Reading changes nothing.
name: get_plan_usage

in_use.description: Active transfers in the account. It can exceed the limit after the plan changed.

active_transfers.description: Null unless the account has an active paid plan. Null means this account is not measured against an active-transfer allowance; it does not mean zero transfers remain. Free accounts have no active-transfer cap; lookup and request rate limits still apply. get_account gives the subscription status.

added_this_period.description: Transfers added in the current billing period, extra ones included. Deleting a transfer does not lower it.

additional_added_this_period.description: Of those, the extra transfers billed on the renewal invoice.

additional_transfers.description: Extra transfers allowed in each billing period beyond the included ones, billed on the renewal invoice at the package's pro-rated rate.

included_transfers.description: Transfers included in each billing period.

period_start.description: When the current billing period started.

resets_at.description: When the next billing period starts and the count begins again.

package.description: Null unless the account has a custom package. Adds stop with monthly_limit_reached once added_this_period reaches included_transfers plus additional_transfers.

id.description: free, rescue, monitor, monitor_20, or operator for the retired Operator plan.

title: Get plan usage
